## Wrangling Our Data

This document was complied from a shared google document.

Genre data was pulled by hand from wikipedia pages for songs, using the first genre listed. If no genre was listed, the genre was derived from the album the song appears on. The genres found were:

1.  Rock- contains all sub genres, hard rock, soft rock, prog rock, art rock, glam rock, yacht rock, heartland rock, etc.
2.  Pop-contains all sub genres art-pop, synth-pop, new-wave, electropop, etc.
3.  Soul
4.  Disco-contains post-disco
5.  R&B
6.  Funk
7.  Jazz
8.  Country
9.  Dance-contains House
10. Hip-Hop- contains New Jack Swing
11. Punk
12. Rap

Sub-genres of music, rock and pop especially, were combined into one category because of the variety of sub-genres available. If they had been divided into each individual type of rock or pop, we may not be able to visualize trends when presenting our data later.

### Danielle, 2010 and 2015


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: Danielle 2010  2015

library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(rvest)

music_2010<-read_html("Data/Raw/2010_songs.html")

table_2010<-music_2010%>%
  html_elements("table.wikitable")%>%
  html_table()

raw_2010<-table_2010[[1]]

raw_2010<-raw_2010%>%
  mutate(year=2010)

genres_2010<-read_csv("Data/Raw/Genres_2010.csv")

raw_2010<-raw_2010%>%
  mutate(Title=str_remove_all(Title, '"'))

genres_2010<-genres_2010%>%
  mutate(Title=str_remove_all(Title, '"'))

combined_2010<-raw_2010%>%
  left_join(genres_2010,join_by(Title))

combined_2010%>%
  filter(is.na(Genre))

music_2015<-read_html("Data/Raw/2015_songs.html")

table_2015<-music_2015%>%
  html_elements("table.wikitable")%>%
  html_table()

raw_2015<-table_2015[[1]]

raw_2015<-raw_2015%>%
  mutate(year=2015)

raw_2015<-raw_2015%>%
  mutate(Title=str_remove_all(Title, '"'))

genres_2015<-read_csv("Data/Raw/Genres_2015.csv")

genres_2015<-genres_2015%>%
  mutate(Title=str_remove_all(Title, '"'))

combined_2015<-raw_2015%>%
  left_join(genres_2015,join_by(Title))

combined_2015%>%
  filter(is.na(Genre))

combined_2010<-combined_2010%>%
  rename("No."="No..x")%>%
  select(-No..y)%>%
  select(-Artist)

combined_2015<-combined_2015%>%
  rename("No."="No..x")%>%
  select(-No..y)%>%
  select(-Artist)

write_csv(combined_2010,"Data/Processed/songs_2010.csv")

write_csv(combined_2015,"Data/Processed/songs_2015.csv")

 #The final genre labels I used are: pop, rock, hip hop, and country.

```

### Grayson, 1995, 2000, 2005


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: Grayson 1995 2000 2005

songs_1995<-read_csv("Data/Raw/1995_songs_with_genres (1).csv")

songs_2000<-read_csv("Data/Raw/2000_songs_with_genres (1).csv")

songs_2005<-read_csv("Data/Raw/2005_songs_with_genres (1).csv")

songs_1995<- songs_1995 |> 
  mutate(No. = row_number(), .before = 1, 
         year= 1995)

songs_2000<- songs_2000 |> 
  mutate(No. = row_number(), .before = 1,
         year= 2000)

songs_2005<- songs_2005 |> 
  mutate(No. = row_number(), .before = 1,
         year= 2005)


songs_1995_2005<- bind_rows(songs_1995, songs_2000, songs_2005)


songs_1995_2005 <- songs_1995_2005 |>
  mutate(
    g = str_to_lower(str_trim(Genre)),
    Genre_category = case_when(
      str_detect(g, "rap rock")~ "Rock",
      str_detect(g, "\\brap\\b") ~ "Rap",
      str_detect(g, "hip.?hop|new jack swing|g-funk|^crunk$|^snap$|^trap$") ~ "Hip Hop",
      str_detect(g, "punk|^emo$") ~ "Punk",
      str_detect(g, "folk|country")~ "Country",
      str_detect(g, "reggae|r&b|&b$|doo-wop")~ "R&B",
      str_detect(g, "soul|gospel") ~ "Soul",
      str_detect(g, "disco") ~ "Disco",
      str_detect(g, "funk")~ "Funk",
      str_detect(g, "jazz") ~ "Jazz",
      str_detect(g, "rock|grunge") ~ "Rock",
      str_detect(g, "pop|new wave|synth|^latin$|worldbeat")  ~ "Pop",
      str_detect(g, "dance(?!hall)|house|techno|trance|^electro$|dancehall")   ~ "Dance",
    )
  ) |>
  select(-g)

songs_1995_2005 |> 
  filter(is.na(Genre_category))

okabe_ito <- unname(palette.colors(palette = "Okabe-Ito")) 

songs_1995_2005<- songs_1995_2005 |> 
  mutate(Genre=Genre_category) |> 
  select(-Genre_category)

songs_1995_2005<-songs_1995_2005%>%
  rename("Title"="Song","Artist(s)"="Artist")

write_csv(songs_1995_2005,"Data/Processed/songs_1995_2005.csv")

```

### Emma, 1980, 1985, 1990


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: Emma 1980 1985 1990

#1980s

music_1980<-read_html("Data/Raw/music_1980.html")

table_1980<-music_1980%>%
  html_elements("table.wikitable")%>%
  html_table()

raw_1980<-table_1980[[1]]

raw_1980<-raw_1980%>%
  mutate(year=1980)

genres_1980<-read_csv("Data/Raw/DataProject - 1980 (1).csv")

raw_1980<-raw_1980%>%
  mutate(Title=str_remove_all(Title, '"'))

combined_1980<-raw_1980%>%
  left_join(genres_1980,join_by(Title))

combined_1980%>%
  filter(is.na(Genre))

write_csv(combined_1980,"Data/Processed/songs_1980.csv")

#1985

music_1985<-read_html("Data/Raw/music_1985.html")

table_1985<-music_1985%>%
  html_elements("table.wikitable")%>%
  html_table()

raw_1985<-table_1985[[1]]

raw_1985<-raw_1985%>%
  mutate(year=1985)

raw_1985<-raw_1985%>%
  mutate(Title=str_remove_all(Title, '"'))

genres_1985<-read_csv("Data/Raw/DataProject - 1985 (1).csv")

combined_1985<-raw_1985%>%
  left_join(genres_1985,join_by(Title))

combined_1985%>%
  filter(is.na(Genre))

write_csv(combined_1985,"Data/Processed/songs_1985.csv")

#1990
music_1990<-read_html("Data/Raw/music_1990.html")

table_1990<-music_1990%>%
  html_elements("table.wikitable")%>%
  html_table()

raw_1990<-table_1990[[1]]

raw_1990<-raw_1990%>%
  mutate(year=1990)

raw_1990<-raw_1990%>%
  mutate(Title=str_remove_all(Title, '"'))

genres_1990<-read_csv("Data/Raw/DataProject - 1990.csv")

combined_1990<-raw_1990%>%
  left_join(genres_1990,join_by(Title))

combined_1990%>%
  filter(is.na(Genre))

combined_1990<-combined_1990%>%
  distinct(No.,.keep_all=TRUE)

combined_1990<-combined_1990%>%
  mutate(Genre=case_when(Genre=="Hip-Hop"~"Hip Hop",TRUE~Genre))

write_csv(combined_1990,"Data/Processed/songs_1990.csv")

```

### Combining all datasets into one


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: combining all songs

combined_songs<-rbind(combined_1980,combined_1985,combined_1990,songs_1995_2005,combined_2010,combined_2015)

write_csv(combined_songs,
          "Data/Processed/combined_songs_all.csv")

```

The file "combined_songs_all.csv" now contains the No., Title, Artist(s), Genre, and year columns for 1980, 1985, 1990, 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, and 2015. We can use this to make visualizations of change over time.
